The Dubai wedding cake guide

Planning a wedding in Dubai? This guide covers what to know before you order a wedding cake: flavours, prices, delivery and the questions couples ask us most.

Our favourite wedding cake flavours

Red velvet, salted caramel and saffron with cardamom are the flavours we see most at Dubai weddings this year.

Sugar flowers or fresh flowers

Sugar flowers last all night in the heat; fresh flowers need a florist on site.

Prices and sizes

Cakes are priced per slice. Ask each bakery for a written quote that includes delivery.

Delivery and setup

Most bakeries deliver and set up the cake at the venue on the day.

FAQ

How far in advance should I order my wedding cake?

Three to six months before the wedding is safe.

Do you deliver outside Dubai?

Many bakeries deliver to Abu Dhabi and Sharjah for an extra fee.
